d:
From the race-track to the village roads, DRIVE THRU by Parmish Verma & Wazir Patar is a ride through the world of the boys - song all yours
Tune in to VICTORY LAP - Parmish Verma's first-ever album. Press play and let every track speak for itself.
Credits:
Singer - Parmish Verma Ft. Wazir Patar
Lyrics - Guri Lahoria
Music - Devilo
Video - Kaalp'Nik & Nishit Basumatary
Camera Team - Mohit Dhankher, Jaspreet Singh, Abhishek Kumar, Anand Thakur, Deepak FPV
